description: ADDITIVE permission set for the chat widget window (label panel-chat, registry kind 'chat' — widget-system.md Phase 4). The panel-* glob in panels.json already grants the dock/snap surface; this capability adds what the conversation needs beyond a settings panel: attachments (file dialog), machine access (local shell), thread persistence, the voice surface (PTT + speech), launching other widgets (gear → settings launcher; artifact pop-outs).
